name: AT&T Community & Employee Discounts
description: Up to 20% off unlimited plans for heroes, educators, health care workers, employees, and students
fullDescription: AT&T offers up to 20% off its most popular unlimited plans for military, veterans, teachers, retired first responders, nurses, and physicians, and a similar discount for students, union members, and employees of qualifying companies. A 55+ plan is also available.
whatTheyOffer:
**AT&T Appreciation Savings:**
- Military, veterans, teachers, retired first responders, and their families
- Licensed nurses and physicians
- 20% off Premium 2.0, 15% off Extra 2.0, 10% off Value 2.0 plan lines

**AT&T Signature Savings:**
- Employees of qualifying companies
- Students
- Union members
- Same 20%/15%/10% off on eligible unlimited plans

**55+ Plans:**
- Special pricing for customers 55 and older
howToGetIt:
1. Appreciation discounts: Visit att.com/offers/discount-program/appreciation and provide proof of eligibility
2. Signature/employee and student discounts: Visit att.com/verification/signaturehub
3. 55+: Visit att.com or an AT&T store to sign up for age-verified plans
4. Appreciation and Signature discounts cannot be combined
5. Credits appear within 3 bills
keywords: AT&T, military discount, veteran, first responder, teacher, nurse, physician, student, senior, 55+, Signature Savings, Appreciation Savings, employee discount, 20% off, cell phone, wireless plan, ID.me
